assessment: Competing codes W36C, WA2, WA8 and BYHB-00001. W36C is named for 'Xue Yu Bai Pearl' by CROP and for 'SNOW WHITE-MET.' by Carross (which lists W36C and WA2 together for Qin/Tang 2017-2024); WA2 is named for 'Xue Yu Bai Pearl' by OEMatch/DipYourCar (one lineage). No listing assigns W36C vs WA2 to different years, models or markets; Carross lists both for the same rows. Finish, year, market or trim therefore do NOT demonstrably explain the difference; two codes may also belong to one colour. OPEN.

assessment: Competing HAN and HA4(+HAN).
